question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

The police seized the counterfeit **notes.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"notes"** has multiple meanings in English, which makes it a homonym. In the context of the given sentence, it refers to "currency notes" or "money." (मुद्रा/नोट)

 
 
• **Example: **The bank teller handed me a bundle of crisp notes.
 
 
 
• **"Currency" **refers to the money that is in use in a particular country, especially in the form of paper notes or coins. (मुद्रा)
 
 
• **Example: **The currency of India is the Indian Rupee.
 
 
 
• The sentence mentions the police seizing "counterfeit notes," which are fake money, making "currency" the most appropriate homonym in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Letters **(अक्षर/पत्र): Written characters or a message in written form.

 
 
• **Example: **She wrote letters to her friends while traveling abroad.
 
 
 
• **Music **(संगीत): The art of arranging sounds to produce a harmonious composition.
 
 
• **Example: **Listening to classical music helps me relax.
 
 
 
• **Messages** (संदेश): Information sent from one person to another, typically in written or verbal form.
 
 
• **Example:** I received several messages from my manager regarding the project.
